name: ukiyou
description: A dense magazine blog theme in indigo and saffron: centred masthead, lead story, three-column grid with a numbered sidebar, bold sans headlines over serif text.

color_mode.title: Colour mode
color_mode.description: What a first-time visitor sees. Visitors can still switch with the header toggle.

issue_strip.title: Issue strip
issue_strip.description: Show the issue line above the wordmark.

issue_label.title: Issue label
issue_label.description: Printed in the issue strip; the month and year of the newest post follow it.

home_layout.title: Home page
home_layout.description: Magazine shows the lead story, grid and subscribe band. Page Builder shows the sections of the home page instead (for a business or landing site).

sidebar.title: Home sidebar
sidebar.description: Show the numbered list and topic chips next to the home grid.

subscribe_url.title: Subscribe link
subscribe_url.description: Where the Subscribe button and band lead. Both stay hidden while this is empty.

subscribe_headline.title: Subscribe headline
subscribe_headline.description: Headline of the subscribe band on the home page.
subscribe_headline.default: New stories, twice a month. Nothing else.
